claims.text: The resort is in the historical district of Majorda in South Goa.

findings.quote: Discover everything that this unique area has to offer guests in the historical district of Majorda in South Goa.
findings.note: States the resort is in the historical district of Majorda in South Goa.

claims.text: The architecture is contemporary Goan, using local materials including red laterite stone and teak.

findings.quote: Contemporary Goan architecture combines with local materials, including red laterite stone and teak
findings.note: Covers the contemporary Goan style and both named materials.

claims.text: Open-sided, high-ceilinged public spaces are cooled by reflecting pools and fountains.

findings.quote: The public rooms and corridors, open-sided and high-ceilinged, draw in the lush surroundings, which are cooled by reflecting pools and fountains.
findings.note: Matches every element of the claim.

claims.text: All rooms have a balcony with views of the pool, gardens or paddy fields.

findings.quote: all of which feature a balcony for taking in views of the pool, lush gardens or paddy fields.
findings.note: Says all rooms have a balcony with these views.

claims.text: Loft Rooms are furnished in a contemporary wooden loft style with a touch of Goan tradition.

findings.quote: Furnished in a contemporary wooden loft style with a touch of Goan tradition, the 44 sq m airy and open Loft Rooms
findings.note: Matches the claim exactly.

claims.text: The Diwa Club has its own pool with an open-air jetted tub.

findings.quote: the Diwa Club boasts its pool with an open-air ‘jetted tub’.
findings.note: Confirms the Diwa Club's own pool with an open-air jetted tub.

claims.text: Spa Alila offers a blend of Asian, Western and Ayurvedic treatments.

findings.quote: We offer a unique blend of Asian, Western and Ayurvedic treatments
findings.note: This is the Spa Alila section.

claims.text: The Yoga Studio overlooks lush greenery.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in tranquility at our Yoga Studio, overlooking lush greenery for a truly revitalizing experience.
findings.note: Says the Yoga Studio overlooks lush greenery.

claims.text: Play Alila is the resort's kids' club, with activities and curated experiences for kids 12 and under.

findings.quote: Alila Diwa Goa’s dedicated kids’ club, offers a range of activities and curated experiences, ideal for kids 12 and under.
findings.note: Describes Play Alila as the kids' club for kids 12 and under.

claims.text: The Teen Zone, next to Play Alila, has table tennis, foosball, carrom, chess and scrabble.

findings.quote: Adjacent to Play Alila is the Teen Zone, a chill-out space for teenagers and their families to relax over games of table tennis, foosball, carrom, chess, and scrabble.
findings.note: Covers the location next to Play Alila and all five games.

claims.text: The Alila Mini-Theatre has daily movie screenings.

findings.quote: Mini-Theatre, where daily screenings offer a delightful escape
findings.note: Confirms daily screenings at the Alila Mini-Theatre.

claims.text: Spice Studio serves the coastal cuisines of Kerala, Karnataka and Goa and is built around a banyan tree.

findings.quote: Embark on a coastal odyssey inspired by the culinary traditions of Kerala, Karnataka and Goa at the homestyle coastal restaurant. Built around a majestic banyan tree
findings.note: Covers the cuisines of all three regions and the banyan tree.

claims.text: The infinity pool has partially submerged recliners and overlooks rice paddies and bamboo stands.

findings.quote: an infinity pool with partially submerged recliners overlooking rice paddies and bamboo stands
findings.note: Matches every element of the claim.

claims.text: The Diwa Club is a pet-friendly resort within a resort inside Alila Diwa Goa.

findings.quote: The Diwa Club is a pet-friendly resort within a resort, nestled within Alila Diwa Goa.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: An Alila Moment takes guests on a walk from the resort to a village bakery to learn Goan breadmaking.

findings.quote: Walk from the resort to the village bakery while learning about Goa’s breadmaking legacy and Portuguese culinary imprint.
findings.note: This is part of the Meet the Poder breadmaking Alila Moment.

claims.text: An Alila Moment tours a working feni distillery with maker Mr. Hansel.

findings.quote: Tour the working distillery with Mr. Hansel, observing each step of the process from harvest to fermentation to bottling.
findings.note: Confirms the distillery tour with Mr. Hansel.

findings.quote: you’ll meet Mr. Hansel, a passionate a widely celebrated feni maker
findings.note: Identifies Mr. Hansel as a feni maker.

claims.text: The resort has high-pitched roofs, wide verandas and tranquil courtyards.

findings.quote: High-pitched roofs, wide verandas and tranquil courtyards set the scene for a restorative stay.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: The resort is not on the beach; Gonsua Beach is 500 meters from the resort.

findings.quote: Gonsua Beach is only 500 meters from the resort. We operate a free beach shuttle to and from the beach for all our guests daily
findings.note: The 500 m distance and the shuttle show the resort is not on the beach.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the rooms are not well soundproofed.

findings.quote: the rooms are not well soundproofed
findings.note: Condé Nast Traveler lists this among its quibbles.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes tour groups can diminish the exclusive feel.

findings.quote: tour groups can diminish the otherwise exclusive feel of the resort
findings.note: Condé Nast Traveler lists this among its quibbles.
